name: Ledger Live
description: electron-updater baseline plus an independent pinned-EC-pubkey chain-of-trust with key rotation; disables under App Store distribution.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Ledger Live’s non-store updater includes SHA-512 integrity checks and signature verification with key rotation chained from a pinned EC key. Store distributions use a separate channel; release and platform coverage remain bounded to the inspected snapshot.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study checkout; this review did not validate released artifacts, endpoint deployment, or platform-specific packaging behavior beyond the checked store-distribution branch.

original_evidence.text: | Ledger Live (desktop) | https://github.com/LedgerHQ/ledger-live | 3bbaa09 / 2026-08-20 | Y | Y (autoDownload=true, autoInstallOnAppQuit=true) — disabled entirely for store distributions (`isStoreDistribution()`) | Y | https (electron-updater GitHub/S3 feed `https://resources.live.ledger.app/...`; extra fetch via `@ledgerhq/live-network`, no TLS override found) | Y (electron-updater's own OS-signature/hash check) PLUS an additional independent verification layer | SHA-512 hash of downloaded file verified against a hash file, whose signature is verified with RSA/EC pubkey chain-of-trust (key rotation: new keys must be signed by the previous key) | pinned-in-binary — `src/main/updater/ledger-pubkey.ts` hardcodes a PEM EC public key baked into the app, used as root of trust for `getNextKey`/`getNextKeySignature` chain | apps/ledger-live-desktop/src/main/updater/init.ts:1-74 (autoUpdater config, verify() call after update-downloaded); createElectronAppUpdater.ts:1-27 (hash+sig+pubkey URLs); createAppUpdater.ts:13-73 (verify hash+signature, key-rotation chain, throws on failure); ledger-pubkey.ts:1-6 (pinned PEM key) |
